prompt:

Same visual world as the reference: warm newsprint paper #e6d8c6 with fiber grain, carbon ink #040303, extra-condensed athletic gothic for names, Barlow Condensed agate labels, 3px solid black rules, square-cut everything, no rounded corners, no shadows, no glass. BTC silks red #e42c22 square; ETH silks blue #0756d0 square. Purse green #085324 for money only. This is a designed website form, not a racetrack photo, not a poster.

The reference supplies palette, type, rules, silks squares, and stamp character. Do NOT copy the reference layout (no giant selected-horse call, no BACK THIS HORSE sidebar, no program strip of other horses).

Title ENTER A HORSE in a 3px ink rectangle. (3) Numbered lines stacked 01 to 05, full width, generous type: 01 NAME underline (WARDEN); 02 MARKET two silks chips BTC pressed / ETH; 03 STRATEGY short description line; 04 BOT WALLET chips SAME AS CREATOR pressed / OTHER ADDRESS with address underline; 05 OPENING PURSE large 250.00 USDso with +10 +50 +100 +250 chips. (5) No preview column, no other horses, no left-page lesson. Form state.

Visitor job (fill one slip and stamp) must be readable from the image alone. No neon, no Inter, no fake TVL.
